<div
  class="pdf-preview-host"
  data-pdf-src="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xfLNqHvbw_fiDvqC5e5V6ux7F_8Ltmnt/preview"
  data-pdf-title="Research Statement PDF"
></div>

<script>
(() => {
  const host = document.querySelector(".pdf-preview-host[data-pdf-src]");
  const load = () => {
    const frame = document.createElement("iframe");
    frame.className = "pdf-frame";
    frame.src = host.dataset.pdfSrc;
    frame.title = host.dataset.pdfTitle;
    frame.allow = "autoplay";
    host.replaceChildren(frame);
  };

  if (document.readyState === "complete") {
    window.setTimeout(load, 250);
  } else {
    window.addEventListener("load", () => window.setTimeout(load, 250), { once: true });
  }
})();
</script>
